collections.hyssop: Discover Hyssop, the biblical herb of purification, named throughout Scripture from the Passover of Exodus 12 to David's prayer in Psalm 51:7: "Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean." Our Hyssop anointing oil is crafted from Hyssopus officinalis in olive oil with Polyphenol Alpha (α)™, our complex of polyphenols from biblical botanicals. Made for prayers of repentance, cleansing, and renewal, it also nourishes the skin.
collections.rose-of-sharon: Named for the flower of Song of Solomon 2:1, "I am the rose of Sharon, and the lily of the valleys," our Rose of Sharon anointing oil speaks of beauty, love, and divine grace. It is crafted from Cistus ladaniferus in olive oil with Polyphenol Alpha (α)™, our complex of polyphenols from biblical botanicals. Made for worship, devotion, consecration, and intercession, it also nourishes the skin. Natural, paraben-free, and vegan.
collections.spikenard: Spikenard, the precious oil Mary of Bethany poured out to anoint Jesus before His death (John 12:3), holds a place of deep significance in Scripture. Our Spikenard anointing oil is crafted from Nardostachys jatamansi in olive oil with Polyphenol Alpha (α)™, our complex of polyphenols from biblical botanicals. The same revered fragrance that filled the house at Bethany, in an oil that also nourishes the skin.
collections.frankincense-myrrh: Frankincense and myrrh, gifts the Magi laid before the Christ child (Matthew 2:11), are two of the most revered botanicals in Scripture. Choose the Frankincense & Myrrh blend, or each oil on its own. Every one is crafted in olive oil with Polyphenol Alpha (α)™, our complex of polyphenols from biblical botanicals, and made for prayer, worship, and blessing. These oils nourish both skin and spirit.
collections.gethsemane: Our Gethsemane anointing oil is pure and unscented, crafted from olive-derived squalane in honor of the ancient olive trees of the garden of Gethsemane, where Jesus prayed (Matthew 26:36). With Polyphenol Alpha (α)™, our complex of polyphenols from biblical botanicals, it hydrates the skin and keeps you close to the tradition of prayer and anointing. Natural, paraben-free, and vegan.
collections.latter-rain: Inspired by the biblical promise of the latter rain (Joel 2:23), a picture of revival, restoration, and abundant blessing, our Latter Rain anointing oil carries the spirit of renewal. It is crafted from botanical extracts in olive oil with Polyphenol Alpha (α)™, our complex of polyphenols from biblical botanicals. Made for prayer meetings, revival, and personal renewal, in an oil that also nourishes the skin.
collections.lily-of-the-valley: Celebrate the Lily of the Valley, the beloved flower of Song of Solomon 2:1. Our Lily of the Valley anointing oil carries the delicate essence of this biblical botanical with Polyphenol Alpha (α)™, our complex of polyphenols from biblical botanicals. Made for devotion and prayer and a sense of sacred peace, it nourishes the skin while honoring sacred tradition.
collections.pomegranate: The pomegranate is one of the seven species of the Promised Land (Deuteronomy 8:8), woven into the hem of the high priest's robe and carved into the pillars of the temple. Our Pomegranate anointing oil is crafted from Punica granatum in olive oil with Polyphenol Alpha (α)™, our complex of polyphenols from biblical botanicals. Made for consecration, prayer, and worship that gives thanks for God's abundant blessing, it also nourishes the skin.
collections.serums: Our 100% olive squalane, the base of every anointing oil we make, offered on its own. From the olive, the tree whose oil lit the tabernacle and anointed kings, it is light, vegan, and sustainably sourced. It absorbs quickly, moisturizes, and leaves the skin soft and supple.
collections.all-products: Every Mount of Olives anointing oil and our 100% olive squalane, crafted from the botanicals Scripture names: frankincense, myrrh, spikenard, hyssop, pomegranate, rose of Sharon, and lily of the valley.
